_comment: One row of compliance_audit_ledger (app.ledger.models) as a SEBI auditor or compliance officer would see it via the audit-trail export (app.analytics.aggregator's AuditTrailEntry). The 'explanation' array inside 'details' is written by app.explainability.explainer.explain_policy_outcome_deterministic at the same time as everything else in this row, via app.ledger.integration.build_ledger_events -- it is therefore covered by payload_digest (see app.ledger.hash_chain.canonical_payload) exactly like every other field here: altering the explanation text after the fact breaks the recomputable hash chain the same way altering the violation text or the clause_hash would.

violations: Upfront Margin is 15 %, which fails the required condition (>= 20 %, clause 4.2.b)
explanation: Trade rejected: Margin collected (15%) is below the mandatory SEBI threshold (20%) required by SEBI Master Circular Clause 4.2.b (SEBI/HO/MIRSD/DOP/CIR/P/2024/100).
